integrity: The proof specifies the integral chain action. Complete graph and character tests and exact Smith-normal-form computations are independently reconstructible using supplied standalone scripts. Independent external validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The integral S5-representation and its coinvariants are established for one canonical finite complex; no integral orbit-space homology or general theorem for other graphs is claimed. The structural join is an elementary consequence of the known Petersen strong edge coloring, rather than a separate novelty claim. Unindexed equivalent equivariant computations cannot be excluded.
title: The integral \(S_5\)-module of the radius-two Petersen line-graph Rips complex
